header.name: mc-test-lib guard-and-effect probes
header.description: In-engine probes for two open points: the 27 Entity methods whose validity guard an arity error hid, and whether effect replacement compares against the duration applied or the duration remaining. Run /mctest3:guards and /mctest3:effects (or the /scriptevent equivalents) and copy the [mctest] lines from chat or the content log.
